record.question: Who amongst the following did not win Bharat Ratna 2019?
record.explanation: Answer C: Teejan Bai. The President’s Secretariat announced the 2019 Bharat Ratna recipients on 25 January: Nanaji Deshmukh, Bhupen Hazarika and Pranab Mukherjee. Teejan Bai is absent from that complete list, so she is the person who did not receive the 2019 Bharat Ratna. Historical/source note: The awards had been announced before the April paper; their investiture ceremony followed in August 2019. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1561485&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
